CustomField.description: After an orphaned household is merged with NPSP triggers disabled, make the kept contact's mailing address the household's single default NPSP Address. Single-member households only; skipped when the contact has an address override or the household has seasonal addresses. Requires Disable NPSP Triggers on Orphan Merge. No effect when NPSP is not installed.
